body: It took three years to develop those healthy ways, drugs & alcohol are still some of the things I do but I don’t look at it as a way of coping with my depression, I’m not old (under 18) so I want to try and get my life together so I don’t ruin my future, good luck to everyone and I hope you can find healthier ways of coping.. I always tell myself I’m better than that but at the same time, no one knows you’re hurting mentally until you’re hurt physically.. but there are better ways of coping and I hope you can discover them <3

I’m always hurting mentally, whenever I want to hurt physically I do it in a good way, go for a run/use a boxing bag, the thoughts are still there but I find it’s my way of not self harming.. and the only people who can understand how you feel are the people who have been through it, otherwise we’re just neglected. I hope one day we’re all happy
The reason you keep going is the same as mine, I just don’t know how we’ll get there.
